items.en: Guards with painted halberds stand in rows, the banquet hall congeals with clear fragrance. Wind and rain arrive from the sea, cooling the leisure pool pavilion.

items.t: 淒淒去親愛，泛泛入煙霧。  歸棹洛陽人，殘鐘廣陵樹。
items.c: 凄凄去亲爱，泛泛入烟雾。  归棹洛阳人，残钟广陵树。

items.en: Sorrowfully leaving loved ones, drifting into the mist. A returning boat with a man from Luoyang, fading bells in the trees of Guangling.

items.t: 今朝郡齋冷，忽念山中客。  澗底束荊薪，歸來煮白石。
items.c: 今朝郡斋冷，忽念山中客。  涧底束荆薪，归来煮白石。

items.en: This morning the commandery study is cold, suddenly I think of the guest in the mountains. At the bottom of the ravine binding thorny firewood, returning to boil white stones.

items.t: 客從東方來，衣上灞陵雨。  問客何為來，采山因買斧。
items.c: 客从东方来，衣上灞陵雨。  问客何为来，采山因买斧。

items.en: A guest comes from the east, clothes wet with Baling rain. Asking the guest why he comes? To gather herbs and buy an axe.

items.t: 落帆逗淮鎮，停舫臨孤驛。  浩浩風起波，冥冥日沉夕。
items.c: 落帆逗淮镇，停舫临孤驿。  浩浩风起波，冥冥日沉夕。

items.en: Lowering the sail to linger at Huaizhen, stopping the boat near a lonely station. Vast winds raise waves, dark sun sinks into the evening.

items.t: 吏舍跼終年，出郊曠清曙。  楊柳散和風，青山奧雲路。
items.c: 吏舍跼终年，出郊旷清曙。  杨柳散和风，青山奥云路。

items.en: Confined in the official residence all year, going out to the suburbs opens up the clear dawn. Willows scatter the gentle breeze, green mountains hide the cloud path.

items.t: 永日方戚戚，出行復悠悠。  女子今有行，大江溯輕舟。
items.c: 永日方戚戚，出行复悠悠。  女子今有行，大江溯轻舟。
items.p: yǒng rì fāng qī qī ， chū xíng fù yōu yōu 。  nǚ zǐ jīn yǒu xíng ， dà jiāng sù qīng zhōu 。

items.en: The long day is filled with sorrow, the journey is long and distant. My daughter is now leaving to marry, the light boat goes up the great river.

items.t: 汲井漱寒齒，清心拂塵服。  閒持貝葉書，步出東齋讀。
items.c: 汲井漱寒齿，清心拂尘服。  闲持贝叶书，步出东斋读。
